name: Shinohara Yuki
source: Class rep for Barding About. Served as a cultural festival committee representative in his previous year, and embodies the concept of what being a Kohnodai Academy student is about. He is firm with his opinions and speaks with an acute awareness of being a Kohnodai student, earning the trust of both Hiyama and Hasumi from the student council.
